title: Analysis of professional reintegration processes and specific needs when post-COVID-19 patients return to work
summary: A systematic analysis of reintegration processes and the return to work of post-COVID patients is to be carried out, identifying challenges, support needs and support measures.

interventions.name: The observation group consists of post-COVID patients of working age (18-67 years) undergoing outpatient treatment. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Post-COVID patients of working age (18-67 years) who make use of the post-COVID consultation hours
- Sufficient language skills to answer the questionnaires
Exclusion criteria:
- Lack of willingness to participate
- Insufficient language skills
- Excessive mental or physical stress that would make participation in the study unreasonable (medical assessment)
